# Roadmap

This is the direction I want the project to go.  If you're looking for a way to help, these are great items to work on!  All contributions are welcome 😋   

## Version 1.0.0
1. create a way to apply language specific highlighting rules to override the defaults applied to all languages (i got this one)
2. improve syntax highlighting robustness for many languages (especially python and rust)
3. mimic jetbrains syntax highlighting as close as reasonably as possible
4. mimic jetbrains editor window, gutter, scrollbar, cursorline highlighting
5. ~~get fonts to work~~
6. fix variable naming conventions and organizations to match with jetbrains settings
7. ~~update/fix release system docs and issue template (i got this one, too 😜)~~
8. Add cool cursor customizations

## Version 2.0.0
1. add ability to save custom theme palette.  possibly load one in.
2. add more syntax theme variations based on popular jetbrains community themes
3. add variables for text decorations and other settings (like underlines, italics, gutter width etc) so that they can be applied independantly to syntax rules.   tenative
